$comment: One view folder = one lazy bundle (dist/views/<folder>.js). The build registers every type listed here; docs/CONTRACT.md §1, §21.

views.name: Lineage
views.summary: A tree of life over rows that name their parents: x by an ordinal property, image or label marks, splices dashed, the focus row's ancestry as the trunk, extinct lines as stubs or folded into +N; rectangular or radial, pan and zoom, a resizable path panel; a mark opens its record.
